e_ident = b'\x7fELF'  # magic
e_ident += b'\x02'     # 64-bit
e_ident += b'\x01'     # little endian
e_ident += b'\x01'     # ELF version
e_ident += b'\x00'     # OS/ABI
e_ident += b'\x00' * 8 # padding

# ELF header
elf = e_ident
elf += struct.pack('<H', 2)    # e_type: ET_EXEC
elf += struct.pack('<H', 62)   # e_machine: EM_X86_64

elf += struct.pack('<H', 64)   # e_ehsize
elf += struct.pack('<H', 56)   # e_phentsize
elf += struct.pack('<H', 1)    # e_phnum
elf += struct.pack('<H', 64)   # e_shentsize
elf += struct.pack('<H', 0)    # e_shnum
elf += struct.pack('<H', 0)    # e_shstrndx

elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x400000)  # p_paddr
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x1000)    # p_filesz
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x1000)    # p_memsz
elf += struct.pack('<Q', 0x200000)  # p_align
